LanguageData.EssenceReplicating.label: Essence Extracted
LanguageData.EssenceReplicating.description: To Weazels, Essence is the most precious resource of all. Rather than extracting it recklessly, they usually keep their captives alive in order to harvest more Essence over the long term.\nEssence regenerates over time, and once it has sufficiently recovered, it can be extracted again.\nIn desperate times, however, some Weazels attempt to forcibly extract Essence from captives who have not yet regenerated. In such cases, the excessive extraction leaves the captive dead, or in a state not far from it.
LanguageData.Weazel_Slavesuit.label: Essence Extraction
LanguageData.Weazel_Slavesuit.description: The subject is undergoing continuous Essence extraction, carefully regulated to avoid permanent physical damage. This grueling process yields an average of 15 Essence per day.
LanguageData.Weazel_BionicTail.label: Bionic Weazel Tail
LanguageData.Weazel_BionicTail.description: A Weazel tail whose artificial nature is impossible to spot at a glance. It corrects the user's gait, assisting their movement.
LanguageData.Weazel_BladeTail.label: Weazel Blade Tail
LanguageData.Weazel_BladeTail.description: The only thing better than an ordinary tail is a tail with a blade on it. Special, stylish, and quite handy for killing anyone who gets on your nerves.
LanguageData.Weazel_BladeTail.comps.0.tools.0.label: blade
LanguageData.WeazelColloidArm.label: Weazel Colloid Arm
LanguageData.WeazelColloidArm.description: A gel-like fist formed through Weazel technology.
LanguageData.WeazelColloidArm.comps.0.tools.0.label: fist
LanguageData.EssenceHigh.label: Essence High
LanguageData.EssenceHigh.description: In a state of extreme stimulation and euphoria induced by refined Essence.
LanguageData.EssenceAddiction.label: Essence Addiction
LanguageData.EssenceAddiction.description: Addicted to Essence. Once addicted, the user becomes entirely dependent on the substance in a relentless pursuit to recapture its intense euphoria.
LanguageData.EssenceAddiction.stages.1.label: withdrawal
LanguageData.EssenceTolerance.label: Essence Tolerance
LanguageData.EssenceTolerance.description: Repeated administration of Essence breeds familiarity with its euphoria, amplifying the sense of diminishing returns and worsening the drop-off.
LanguageData.EssenceSmokeleafHigh.label: High on Essence Blow
LanguageData.EssenceSmokeleafHigh.description: Essence carried in on the smoke is coursing through the veins. A strange euphoria and a sharp sense of focus set in.
LanguageData.EssenceSmokeleafTolerance.label: Essence Blow Tolerance
LanguageData.EssenceSmokeleafTolerance.description: A built-up tolerance to Essence Blow. The higher the tolerance, the more Essence Blow is needed to achieve the same effect.
LanguageData.EssenceSmokeleafAddiction.label: Essence Blow Dependence
LanguageData.EssenceSmokeleafAddiction.description: Essence Blow is not very addictive, but it is still useful—and dangerous.
LanguageData.EssenceSmokeleafAddiction.stages.1.label: withdrawal
LanguageData.EssenceReplicating.comps.0.messageOnDisa: {PAWN_nameDef}'s Essence has fully regenerated and can be extracted again.
